changes.what: New rows builder (r4 copy). Every refusal sentence now comes from primitives.sentences.mjs (S(key)); adds the e28 rows; adds computed notes for round 3 timings and the curved 3e-4 bar. primitives.json is its output (deterministic, two runs identical).
Rebuilt by r5: 62 rows (was 61). Seeds 4 and 5 held-out proof (635 / 501 inputs, accepted-and-wrong 0) and 1335 planar inputs are now what the rows say.

New. One real input per quoted sentence, run through its producer (interpreter, call-lint, guard, budgetSentence); lints each for engine words and for being one sentence; checks bench.html template equals budgetSentence. Run: bun primitives.sentences.mjs

Wording only: removed '(the mesh cannot resolve it)'; num() prints 1e-4 as 0.0001 (was 1.00 x 10^-4 above 1e-6); sentenceProblems also flags mesh/tessell/wasm/face ids; new export budgetSentence(call, seconds). No limit and no rule changed.
New lintUnknownOption (one-sentence form of the interpreter's two-sentence 'has no option called'), added first in lintScript.
sentenceFor template changed to the same generic budget sentence (old one advised a bigger corner for a ring).
New spec: 11 wedge and 13 prism cases (n 3..12, at, single-axis turns).
New checker: truck bbox/COM/volume vs a kernel-free closed form (bar 1e-9 of diagonal written before the run). 24 of 24 pass, worst bbox 2.2e-16.
